facts.claim: The official walking route connects Porta do Sol, Policarpo Sanz and Alameda via Colón.
facts.sourceLocation: The next stop ... Porta do Sol ... along Policarpo Sanz Street ... Colón Street ... Alameda park.

facts.claim: Porta do Sol has the O Sireno sculpture; Policarpo Sanz has period architecture; Alameda has trees, fountains and gardens.
facts.sourceLocation: sculpture of O Sireno by Francisco Leiro; fine examples of period architecture; trees, fountains, sculptures and gardens.

notes: Official source captured with proxy and normal TLS; relevant passages read. Dated prior-season content is not evidence for 2026 dates. Route, budgeting and pacing suggestions are original editorial advice.
